0022600004.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Timberwolves visit the Miami Heat, with Minnesota's first game of the season coming on the road. Minnesota won both meetings with Miami in 2025-26, including a 122-94 win in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026. For the Timberwolves, Donte DiVincenzo is out following Achilles surgery and Rocco Zikarsky is day-to-day with a game-time decision for an undisclosed reason, while Miami's Vladislav Goldin is day-to-day with a game-time decision because of an ankle injury.
